name: Felix Solis
bio: Felix Solis (born September 17, 1971 in New York City, New York) is an American actor, voice actor, film director and film producer. He is best known for his role as Omar Navarro in the Netflix series Ozark. Solis also provided the voice of Jerry Martinez, the main antagonist in a 2006 action-adventure game Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories developed by Rockstar Games.
place: New York City, New York, USA
